caption: The drawing depicts the upper portion of a chair back against a plain, light background. The chair back is dark brown or black with gold ornamental designs. The top horizontal rail is rounded and features gold leaf-like and vine motifs. The vertical uprights show elongated gold decorations and an oval shape near the top, interrupted at the center by a larger rectangular element. The central horizontal splat is adorned with symmetrical golden floral and scrollwork decorations, including stylized flowers, leaves, and curving stems. Below the decorated splat, there is another plain horizontal rail of the same dark color, without additional ornamentation. The legs of the chair, visible at the bottom, are wrapped near the base with gold-colored bands. The composition is centered on the page, and the name “Lawrence Flynn” is signed in cursive in the bottom right corner.
title: Back of Hitchcock Chair
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
